text: Whether you run one business or fifty, it feels the same. Your phone never stops buzzing, and everyone wants an answer, right now.
A new lead comes in, and nobody answers. A lead that waits an hour is far less likely to reply. Three days later, they have gone elsewhere.
Appointments come and go, and nobody marks what happened. Was it a show, or a no-show? Nobody knows.
The no-shows never get a call back. They just sit in the calendar, and slip away.
Good deals sit untouched, until they quietly turn grey, and fall out of the pipeline.
Meanwhile, the same contact turns up again, and again, and again, clogging your CRM.
And every month, you build the reports by hand. You are not careless. You just cannot watch every account, all day.
Then a customer comes back, and tells you something you did not know. And you find out when they tell you.
SubSync brings it all together.
It connects to every business you manage, watches your leads and appointments, finds what is going wrong, and puts a dollar figure on it.
Then it shows you what to do first, with all your accounts in one place.

Every morning, start with Today. It shows which connected accounts need attention, and what is at risk: about seven hundred and fifty-one thousand dollars, across eighty-seven quiet deals. Below it are the accounts to save first. Open one, and you know exactly where to focus.
Here is how a lead gets lost. A new lead arrives. Nobody replies. The timer keeps growing, and soon it is past your target.
Speed to lead catches it. Thirteen new leads are past your target right now. Each one shows how long it has waited, so you know who to call first, longest wait on top.

Appointments tell the truth. Four have no outcome marked, so your real show rate is fifty-seven percent. Eight no-shows are waiting to be won back, with a list to call. And the flow tree shows which person, or which calendar, is losing your bookings.

The funnel shows where every deal sits, step by step, and where the biggest leak is. Replay it day by day. Click any step to open the deals there. And deals with no value still show up, so nothing hides.
Need one lead? Find a lead searches every connected account at once. It shows leads that never had a reply, leads going cold, and ready-made call lists.

Duplicates clog the CRM, and merging by hand is scary. Clean-up found one hundred and sixty-three duplicate groups, sorted by how sure it is: certain, likely, or possible. You preview every change first, bigger changes ask you to type a confirmation, and you can undo. You stay in control.
Clients puts all your connected accounts on one screen. Five need you now, and two paid plans are past due. Payments are right there too, with the money at risk.

The account audit checks every account today. It estimates what you are losing, about two hundred and fifty-eight thousand dollars a month here, with the working one tap away, and lists what to fix first. You can copy a summary, print it, or see a sample to send a client.
Team shows who follows up fast, and who is overloaded. Here, three things need you today, and one person has four leads waiting more than two hours.
And you do not have to keep checking. Alerts reach you in the app, in Slack, or by email. Each one says what is wrong, what to do next, and links straight to the right account in your CRM.
Bring your connected accounts together. Know what's happening, see what needs attention and take action with SubSync. Install once. Free for 14 days.
